name: Beginner Knitters Circle
description: A warm, judgment-free space for those just picking up their needles. Ask questions, share your first projects, and celebrate every stitch.

name: Advanced Crochet Collective
description: Pushing the limits of crochet — intricate tapestry work, filet crochet, tunisian techniques, sculptural amigurumi, and freeform fiber art.

name: Yarn Dyers Guild
description: Hand dyers, kettle dyers, and indie dye enthusiasts share tips, tricks, color theory, and dye recipes. Support indie dyers!

name: Sock Knitters Anonymous
description: Addicted to knitting socks? Us too. Share your FOs, try-ons, yarn splurges, and heel technique debates. Two at a time or magic loop—all welcome.

name: Slow Fiber Movement
description: From fleece to finished object—we celebrate spinning, weaving, natural dyeing, and the full lifecycle of fiber. Slowing down to appreciate every step.

name: KAL Headquarters
description: The home of KnitHub's knit-alongs. Join seasonal KALs, find project partners, and stay motivated with weekly check-ins and prize drawings.
